form.label: MailGuard: Email Authentication & Spoofing Monitoring
form.description: Defensive SOC Dashboard for SPF, DKIM, DMARC Analysis and Spoofing Detection

search.query: index=security_lab sourcetype="mailguard:analysis" from_domain="$domain_tok$" verdict="$verdict_tok$" | stats count
index=security_lab sourcetype="mailguard:analysis" from_domain="$domain_tok$" verdict="SPOOFED" | stats count

index=security_lab sourcetype="mailguard:analysis" from_domain="$domain_tok$" | stats count as total, count(eval('dmarc.status'!="PASS")) as fails | eval fail_rate=round((fails/total)*100, 1) | fields fail_rate
index=security_lab sourcetype="mailguard:analysis" from_domain="$domain_tok$" verdict="$verdict_tok$" | stats count by verdict

index=security_lab sourcetype="mailguard:analysis" from_domain="$domain_tok$" | eval spf_fail=if('spf.status'!="PASS", 1, 0), dkim_fail=if('dkim.overall_status'!="PASS", 1, 0), dmarc_fail=if('dmarc.status'!="PASS", 1, 0) | timechart span=1h sum(spf_fail) as "SPF Failures", sum(dkim_fail) as "DKIM Failures", sum(dmarc_fail) as "DMARC Failures"

index=security_lab sourcetype="mailguard:analysis" from_domain="$domain_tok$" verdict="$verdict_tok$" | stats count, count(eval(verdict=="SPOOFED")) as spoofed_count, avg(risk_score) as avg_risk by from_domain | eval avg_risk=round(avg_risk, 1) | sort - count | head 15

index=security_lab sourcetype="mailguard:analysis" from_domain="$domain_tok$" risk_score>=70 | table _time, from_address, subject, originating_ip, "spf.status", "dkim.overall_status", "dmarc.status", risk_score, verdict | sort - risk_score

index=security_lab sourcetype="mailguard:analysis" "attachments{}.is_risky"=true OR "attachments{}.is_double_extension"=true | mvexpand "attachments{}" | search "attachments{}.is_risky"=true OR "attachments{}.is_double_extension"=true | table _time, from_address, "attachments{}.filename", "attachments{}.sha256", "attachments{}.detected_extensions{}", risk_score, verdict | sort - _time
